hook.text: You're Pharaoh Khufu, and you want the Great Pyramid, the biggest tomb ever built. But there's a problem.

beats.text: First, you need stone. About two point three million blocks, most heavier than a car. So you open a quarry right next to the Great Pyramid.
But the best white limestone is across the river. So you load it on boats and ride the Nile flood almost to the door. Your inspector Merer even wrote it down in a diary.
Still not enough? The blocks are too heavy to drag across sand. So your workers pour water in front of the sledges. Wet sand cuts the pulling force in half.
Then you hit the wall. You need thousands of workers for twenty years. So you build them a whole town, with bakeries and doctors. Paid workers, not slaves, built the Great Pyramid.
Twenty years later, it's the tallest building on Earth, for almost four thousand years. And people still say aliens built the Great Pyramid, when really
